objective: Prepare for Listening form completion through answer-type prediction, spellings, plurals, decimals and units.

content.material: This is coach-created written preparation, NOT an audio Listening assessment. Predict names/numbers/dates/places from field labels. Preserve decimals and units: 100 cm = 1 m; 100 pence = £1. Follow the word limit and check plurals. These 20 written items cannot prove listening comprehension.
content.strategy: Label → predict answer type → record information → check spelling, decimal, unit, plural and word limit.
